reference_role: Editable logo study used as identity reference; generated boards are raster concept mockups.

briefs.title: 01 Signal
briefs.prompt:
Create a highly polished brand identity exploration board for Doka Studio, a web app helping shop owners in Madagascar turn product photos into promotional posters. This is a visual direction called SIGNAL. Reference image 1 is the exact logo study: preserve the cut-corner capital D symbol, the lowercase doka wordmark and STUDIO descriptor construction and spelling. Recolor it as needed, do not replace it with another mark.
Make ONE cohesive landscape 3:2 art-director presentation board, with a bold Swiss poster grid, large assertive typography, substantial whitespace, razor-sharp 45-degree corner cuts and graphic blocks. Palette: signal yellow #F2C744, charcoal #20201D, warm paper #F5F1E8. Dark lettering on yellow. Avoid yellow or white small lettering on yellow. Tone: friendly commercial creativity with confident print-shop energy, not corporate finance or a generic AI startup.
Include a prominent logo area; a small symbol-only app icon; 3 large named palette swatches; a cropped oversized D as a framing device; and 4 well-crafted application panels. Applications: a desktop website hero with exact headline "Vos produits au premier plan." and one "Créer une affiche" button; a phone with an elegant French poster-creation UI and a product photo preview; a social launch graphic featuring one black headphone product photographed against warm paper with strong yellow typography; and a small welcome/email card. Product imagery belongs in mockups, not inside the logo. UI panels should be believable and quiet: no invented analytics, revenue claims, price offers or customer testimonials. No coffee cups, clothing, bags or stationery stacks. Use a mixture of flat graphic layouts and one subtle photorealistic device view, with considered shadows only on the device.
Text must read "Doka Studio" or the referenced doka/STUDIO lockup, spelled D O K A, never Doka AI. Small section title "01 — SIGNAL". Keep text short and legible, minimal other copy. A sophisticated identity case-study sheet with a clear visual hierarchy, not a website screenshot, not 3D chrome lettering, not a moodboard of unrelated images. Do not include the words Affisoa, Saryko or Vitraka. No AI sparkles, robots, neon gradients, fake certification, watermarks, or unrequested brands. Opaque background.

briefs.title: 02 Editorial
briefs.prompt:
Create a premium brand identity exploration board for Doka Studio, a digital creative studio/app for Malagasy shops creating promotional product posters. Direction EDITORIAL: quiet confidence, contemporary publishing, intimate boutique design practice. Reference image 1 is the exact proposed logo: preserve its cut-corner capital D symbol and the titlecase serif Doka with STUDIO underneath, including spelling and construction. Do not replace the D with a camera or AI icon.
ONE cohesive landscape 3:2 brand presentation board, designed like a beautiful independent design journal. Palette: oxblood #632F35, warm ivory #F5EDE2, muted apricot #E5B39A. Large elegant serif headlines paired with restrained sans-serif UI text, fine rules, warm tactile paper and tiny captions. Radically different visual composition from a tech-startup board: asymmetrical editorial columns, exquisite negative space, a hero serif wordmark, sophisticated large product photography crops, no rounded-card grid everywhere. Brand should still feel affordable and welcoming to small shops, not a fashion house selling perfume.
Show the logo prominently; a symbol-only app icon and black/white miniature logo treatments; three precise color swatches; typography with the French headline "Le beau côté de votre commerce."; and four thoughtful applications: a minimal desktop poster-library interface using large product-image thumbnails and the label "Mes affiches"; a portrait phone creation screen with the short action "Créer une affiche"; an art-directed social launch poster featuring a sculptural unbranded black headphone set on ivory with an oxblood edge; and a tasteful welcome email/header design. Let the D's clipped corner become a subtle page-corner graphic device. Keep the original shop artwork and Doka's service identity clearly distinct; no app-logo watermark stamped onto customer poster previews.
Exact name "Doka Studio" or referenced Doka/STUDIO lockup. Small title "02 — EDITORIAL". Minimal French copy only, no long paragraphs, fake statistics, price claims, subscription numbers or third-party logos. Strong real identity design craft, not a pile of business cards or cafe packaging. One elegant realistic device panel; mostly beautiful flat graphic artwork, readable logos, no glassmorphism, chrome effects, magic wands, AI sparkles or gradients. Opaque background.

briefs.title: 03 Complice
briefs.prompt:
Create an outstanding brand identity exploration board for Doka Studio, an approachable creative app for small shop owners in Madagascar making promotional posters from their own product photos. Direction COMPLICE: a friendly creative partner, expressive but trustworthy. Reference image 1 is the proposed vector logo: preserve its simple cut-corner capital D symbol and lowercase doka / STUDIO name, lettering and correct spelling. Explore the wider identity, not a new name or unrelated logo.
Make ONE landscape 3:2 art-director board. Palette: deep teal #113F43, pale mint #D9F4E6, soft peach #F2B9B1, warm white. Typography is rounded, sturdy and welcoming, with short human French copy. Composition uses a playful but disciplined modular collage: offset portrait panels, broad soft corners contrasted with the D's crisp cut, generous negative space, oversize typographic crops, gently interlocking D-derived frames. No childish cartoons, no mascots, no rainbow tech gradient. Make it clearly a different world from yellow brutalist graphics or a restrained serif magazine.
Show a large clean logo; a deep-teal-on-mint symbol-only app icon; three labeled palette swatches; graphic shapes extracted from the D; and four useful brand applications: a welcoming desktop hero with exact headline "Une photo. Des idées." and button "Créer une affiche"; a phone with a friendly French creation/chat view including a product-photo thumbnail; a confident social launch graphic using unbranded black headphones, mint and peach portrait panels and the name "Doka Studio"; and a simple welcome email/notification card. Product photography should look credible and tactile, never invented offer text. Large visuals and clear typographic hierarchy matter more than tiny UI details.
Use "Doka Studio" or the reference doka/STUDIO lockup, spelled D O K A. Small direction title "03 — COMPLICE". Only minimal short French text. No fake analytics, money amounts, fabricated testimonials, competitor names or certification. Avoid irrelevant tote bags, mugs, stationery piles, AI sparkles, robots, glassy dashboards and 3D inflated logos. Flat branding is primary; one subtle photorealistic device mockup can provide context. Opaque background.
